image_description: A vintage agricultural scene featuring a horse-drawn plow in the foreground right, pulled by two brown horses. A man stands behind the plow guiding it, while another man stands nearby observing. In the background left, there is a large red wagon with spoked wheels carrying people, set against a green field and blue sky with clouds.

Its frame height is approximately waist-to-chest level of the operator, not 'significantly exceeding human height'. This checkpoint describes a much larger implement or misinterprets the scale.
